channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Tehran Accuses U.S. of ‘Reckless’ Attacks After Exchange of Fire in Strait
item.description: The United States attacked Iranian targets after strikes on American ships, despite a proposed peace plan. The United States said it had attacked Iranian military targets in response to strikes on American ships.

item.title: Israeli airstrikes kill five in southern Lebanon as Hezbollah rockets hit open areas in Israel
item.description: The UAE reported a drone and missile attack, challenging a ceasefire. Iran and the US had earlier traded fire, with President Trump dismissing the attacks as minor. Iran and U. S.

item.title: Worldwide race to trace passengers from hantavirus-hit cruise ship
item.description: A global effort is underway to trace passengers from the MV Hondius cruise ship, linked to a hantavirus outbreak. At least 12 countries have been connected to the ship, with the UN health agency confirming five cases of the virus.

item.title: International cyber attack disrupts swathe of universities and schools
item.description: A hacking group breached the academic software Canvas, used by thousands of schools and universities across North America. The cyber attack disrupted a swathe of US and Canada universities and schools, causing widespread disruption to teaching and learning.

item.title: Thousands run Palestine Marathon under shadow of Israel’s war on Gaza
item.description: Thirteen thousand runners participated in the Palestine Marathon to show unity and resilience amid escalating violence in Gaza and West Bank. The event drew global participants. Marathon draws 13,000 runners globally to amplify unity and resilience amid escalating violence in Gaza and West Bank.

item.title: US hopes for ‘serious offer’ from Iran today on latest proposal, despite exchange of strikes
item.description: US President Trump confirmed a ceasefire with Iran remains in place following an exchange of fire between the two countries. The situation escalated tensions, but Trump maintained that the ceasefire agreement holds.

item.title: Amid Diplomatic Efforts, Hostilities Flare in the Gulf
item.description: Hostilities flared in the Gulf despite diplomatic efforts. Amid Diplomatic Efforts, Hostilities Flare in the Gulf Council on Foreign Relations.

item.title: Pentagon Releases "Never-Before-Seen" UFO Files
item.description: The Pentagon released previously unseen UFO files. More files will be released. Additional files will be released by the Department of War on a rolling basis. Pentagon Releases "Never-Before-Seen" UFO Files.

item.title: Italy-US ties strained as pope and Iran war dominate talks
item.description: Italy's ties with the US are strained due to the Iran war and domestic pressure. Rome balances US ties with domestic pressure as the Iran war strains the alliance and fuels economic fallout.

item.title: UAE charts its own course across the Middle East and Africa
item.description: The United Arab Emirates is pursuing an independent foreign policy, despite close relations with Israel and the US. Close relations with Israel and the United States have placed the United Arab Emirates in Iran's crosshairs as Abu Dhabi pursues a more independent foreign policy than many Gulf countries, including Saudi Arabia.

item.title: South Africa president faces call to resign after court ruling
item.description: South Africa's Constitutional Court ruled against blocking impeachment proceedings for President Cyril Ramaphosa. The Constitutional Court says MPs were was wrong to block impeachment proceedings against Cyril Ramaphosa. South Africa president faces call to resign after court ruling.

item.title: The high protein craze: Fad or fixture in the Singaporean diet?
item.description: Singapore's supermarkets are filled with high protein products due to a booming fitness culture. Products claiming to be high in protein are filling up Singapore's supermarket shelves as a result of a booming fitness culture, but health experts warn that not all proteins are created equal.

item.title: Iran turns bombed Karaj Bridge into a symbol of resistance
item.description: Iran's Karaj Bridge was bombed and is now a symbol of resistance. The B1 corridor connects Tehran with northern and northwestern regions that have large Azeri populations. Karaj itself has a substantial Azeri community, while cities further northwest such as Tabriz are overwhelmingly Azeri.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine accuse each other of breaching Victory Day ceasefire
item.description: Russia and Ukraine accused each other of breaching a ceasefire hours after it began, with both sides reporting hundreds of drone attacks. The truce was meant to cover Victory Day celebrations.

item.title: U.A.E. Expels Pakistani Workers, as Pakistan’s Peacemaking Creates a Rift
item.description: The UAE is expelling Pakistani workers as Pakistan's ties to the Emirates deteriorate. As Pakistan mediates between the U. S. and Iran, its ties to the Emirates have deteriorated. Pakistani workers say they are now being sent home en masse.

item.title: Two Men Are Convicted of Spying for China in Britain
item.description: Two men were convicted of spying for China in Britain after surveilling Hong Kong dissidents. The men were arrested in 2024, accused of surveilling dissidents from Hong Kong in Britain.

item.title: India Activates Precautionary Hantavirus Surveillance As Cruise Outbreak Grows
item.description: India activated precautionary hantavirus surveillance as a cruise ship outbreak grows. India activates precautionary surveillance measures as the hantavirus outbreak grows. India Activates Precautionary Hantavirus Surveillance As Cruise Outbreak Grows.

item.title: Emirates Doubles Down on U.S. and Israeli Ties Amid Iran War
item.description: The United Arab Emirates has strengthened its ties with the U. S. and Israel amid the Iran war, doubling down on its alliances. The UAE has been a target of Iranian attacks, hardening its resolve to reassess its relationships.

item.title: Iran claims to have seized ‘offending’ oil tanker in Gulf of Oman
item.description: Iranian forces boarded and detained the Barbados-flagged oil tanker Ocean Koi in the Gulf of Oman. State TV released a video of the IRGC forces detaining the vessel, which Iran claims was involved in "offending" activities.

item.title: US expecting Tehran’s response to peace proposal in hours
item.description: A ceasefire held despite recent strikes by Iran and the US. Israel conducted a hit in Lebanon amid the ongoing conflict. Iran war live: Ceasefire holds despite Iran, US blows; Israel hits Lebanon Al Jazeera.
